targets.rawSql:
SELECT "distance" / 1609.344 AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "elapsedDuration" AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT 1609.344 / NULLIF("averageSpeed", 0) AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "averageHR" AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "maxHR" AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "elevationGain" * 3.28084 AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "calories" AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

SELECT "aerobicTrainingEffect" AS "Value"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

The line color shows the heart rate zone. The zone limits come from the activity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Time", "hrZoneLowBoundary_1" AS "Zone 1", "hrZoneLowBoundary_2" AS "Zone 2", "hrZoneLowBoundary_3" AS "Zone 3", "hrZoneLowBoundary_4" AS "Zone 4", "hrZoneLowBoundary_5" AS "Zone 5"
FROM garmin."ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "activityType" != 'No Activity'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Heart rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Time", 1609.344 / "Speed" AS "Pace"
FROM garmin."ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "Speed" > 0.894
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pace (min/mi)
panels.description: Pace for each moment of the activity. Moments slower than 30:00 per mile are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Time", "DurationSeconds" AS "Elapsed", ("Cadence" + "Fractional_Cadence") * 2 AS "Cadence"
FROM garmin."ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "Cadence" >= 25
ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "Time", "Speed" * 2.23694 AS "Speed"
FROM garmin."ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "Speed" > 0.894
ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "Time", "Speed" * 2.23694 AS "Speed (mph)"
FROM garmin."ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityID" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND "Speed" > 0.894
ORDER BY time
